dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, the movie on Saturday is at eleven a.m.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðə ˈmuːvi ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ɪz ət ɪˈlɛvən ˌeɪˈɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I work from eight to noon.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪ ˈwɜːrk frəm ˈeɪt tə ˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's at a quarter past seven p.m., too.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ət ə ˈkwɔːrtər ˈpæst ˈsɛvən ˌpiːˈɛm, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Let's eat at half past five.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ˈlɛts ˈiːt ət ˈhæf ˈpæst ˈfaɪv.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, I have Thai class at four. A quarter to six?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈhæv ˈtaɪ ˌklæs ət ˈfɔːr. ə ˈkwɔːrtər tə ˈsɪks?
